business_problem: Small and mid-sized businesses needed contract review and management tools that could identify legal risk without forcing every document through slow manual legal review. PowerLaw AI also needed a way to productize its contract intelligence for industry customers through both online and offline channels.
solution_summary: PowerLaw AI built a contract-intelligence platform with Alibaba Cloud so contract review and management could be delivered as repeatable SaaS products instead of custom legal projects. The company uses natural-language processing and large annotated contract corpora to recognize clauses, extract fine-grained contract information, and drive two products: Me-Check for intelligent contract review and MeFlow for data-driven contract management. Together, those services let customers upload a contract and receive high-, medium-, and low-risk labeling, compare multiple versions, manage approval and execution details in one place, and move toward Q&A-driven contract generation. PowerLaw AI then listed the solution on Alibaba Cloud Industry Cloud and used Alibaba Cloud's industry channel system to reach customers through a combined online and offline go-to-market motion. The result is a production legal-AI workflow aimed at faster review, clearer risk ranking, and better contract-data reuse for growing businesses.

solution_components.name: Me-Check
solution_components.role: Performs intelligent contract review with clause recognition, extraction, and risk presentation.

solution_components.name: MeFlow
solution_components.role: Manages contract data and lifecycle workflows after review.

solution_components.name: Alibaba Cloud Industry Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the distribution channel and lightweight deployment surface for industry customers.

solution_components.name: DAMO Academy machine-intelligence products
solution_components.role: Support the underlying AI cooperation used to industrialize contract-intelligence solutions.

data_flow: Customer contracts are uploaded into PowerLaw AI's review pipeline, where NLP models recognize clauses, extract structured information, and assign risk levels. The structured outputs then feed MeFlow for contract management, version comparison, and execution tracking, while Alibaba Cloud Industry Cloud distributes the packaged solution to customers.
business_outcome: PowerLaw AI turned contract review into a packaged legal-AI service for industry customers and SMEs. The platform gives customers faster risk triage, better contract visibility, and a path to digital contract assets instead of isolated legal files, while Alibaba Cloud expands the company's distribution reach.
architecture_clues: Clause recognition and extraction are treated as reusable AI services that feed both review and lifecycle management products.
Risk is surfaced as structured levels rather than only free-text legal commentary.
Go-to-market distribution through Alibaba Cloud Industry Cloud is part of the overall production design.
